input.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, I confirm that the verdict remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Challenge H1 (early filing): The counter-evidence retrieved (E7-E10) contains no financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2026. The evidence is from filings dated October 28, 2026 (for period ending September 30, 2026) and July 29, 2026 (for period ending June 30, 2026), which predate the December 31, 2026 quarter end. No early reporting was found.

Challenge H2 (forward-looking guidance): The counter-evidence (E10-E12) does not contain forward-looking guidance or preliminary results for Q2 FY2027. E12 discusses Q1 FY2027 highlights, and E9/E10 discuss unearned revenue recognition schedules, but none provide actual or forecasted revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2026.

Challenge H3 (period interpretation): This challenge is refuted. E13 clearly shows that as of September 30, 2026, the "Three Months Ending December 31, 2026" is a future period with expected unearned revenue recognition of $30,299 million. This confirms that December 31, 2026 quarter data was not yet available in the September 30, 2026 filing.

The evidence review confirms that E16 (not provided in the original evidence packet but referenced in the review) contains revenue for the comparison period (Q2 FY2026, December 31, 2025) but not for the claim period (Q2 FY2027, December 31, 2026). Without both periods, year-over-year growth cannot be verified.

The claim requires financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2026, which would typically be reported in late January 2027, after the evidence cutoff date of November 1, 2026. No evidence in any packet provides these results.
